page.overview:
What is Fred Weasley II?

Fred Weasley (b. 2000s) was the oldest child of George and Angelina Weasley (née Johnson). He was named in memory of his late uncle, Fred Weasley, who was killed during the Battle of Hogwarts. He had a younger sister named Roxanne.

Fred attended the 2014 Quidditch World Cup with his family.
